name: Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company
summary: Founded in Tainan City, Taiwan, in 1998, Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company operates as a dedicated semiconductor foundry. The firm delivers a suite of advanced process technologies, including InGaP/GaAs HBT, specifically engineered for power amplifier and gain block circuit designs. Additionally, they offer GaAs E/D pHEMT processes, which are ideal for switch and low noise amplifier applications. Their ED BiHEMT technology further enables high-level integration for single-chip solutions, particularly relevant for modern smartphone and WiFi devices. Beyond these core offerings, AWSC's comprehensive services encompass HBT, ED pHEMT, ED BiHEMT, Integrated Passive Devices (IPD), and bumping services tailored for radio frequency and wireless applications, as well as VCSEL/optical solutions.
